description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes a geographic layer identifying roads subject to flooding. Its native metadata places the layer under the municipal civil-protection plan and identifies the municipality as the source, correcting the regional-portal attribution in the earlier catalogue description. The complete description and lineage both state that the data concern flood-prone roads. This provides road-specific hazard exposure information; it does not establish a complete routable network or traffic-flow model. No flood depth, event probability, return period, closure duration or damage estimate is supplied by the inspected descriptive fields. The source lists Shapefile, GeoJSON, GML and KML representations and states CC BY 4.0 with no public-access limitation. The native metadata date is March 2016; the later national-portal modification date describes harvesting and does not establish a newer road survey. Related civil-protection metadata separately describes monitored underpasses and locations for receiving or sheltering evacuees. Those components are retained in a related planning resource and are not counted as additions to this road layer. Current road condition, completeness, download availability and charges remain unverified. No feature, map, archive or dataset body was read.
